**Preserve paste and edit context for the worktrees directory.** When the field contains `~/` or another directory and the user pastes an absolute path, the browser appends the pasted text to the existing value. The blur handler passes that concatenated value with an empty previous value, so `resolvePastedPath` can persist the concatenation. The same call removes `\ ` from typed POSIX paths. Record the pre-paste value and clipboard text. Apply `resolvePastedPath` only to the paste context. For ordinary edits, trim the raw input. This preserves pasted full-path replacement and prevents typed paths from being changed. The persisted value is used as the parent for generated worktrees.
